reason: My buyers already see my WhatsApp broadcasts and my weekend Facebook lives for free, so paying per SMS is a cost I've never needed. Before 11.11 I'm busy with stock and lives, not learning a new portal and fighting with uploading contact lists.
objection: I don't know how to upload my contact list or get the sender name approved, and I don't want to find out the week before a sale that it doesn't work or that my Sinhala messages cost two or three credits each.
would_change_my_mind: Someone setting it up for me: importing my WhatsApp contacts and sending a few free test messages under my name, so I can see if SMS actually brings orders that WhatsApp misses.
